type Ex = Lit int | Ref string | Plus Ex Ex | Block (List Cmd2) Ex
type Cmd2 = Set string Ex | Show Ex
let value env e =
  match e:
    case Lit n: n
    case Ref v: Map.findOr v 0 env
    case Plus a b: value env a + value env b
    case Block body last: value (List.fold runSt env body) last

  match s:
    case Set v e: Map.add v (value env e) env
    case Show e: Map.add "shown" (value env e) env

  match e:
    case Num n: n
    case Add a b: evalE a + evalE b
    case Mul (Num 0) _ | Mul _ (Num 0): 0

    case Neg a: -(evalE a)

    case Add (Num 0) x | Add x (Num 0): shrink x
    case Mul (Num 1) x | Mul x (Num 1): shrink x
    case Neg (Neg x): shrink x
    case Add a b: Add (shrink a) (shrink b)
    case Mul a b: Mul (shrink a) (shrink b)
    case _: e

let add x t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: Node Leaf x Leaf
    case Node l v rt if x < v: Node (add x l) v rt
    case Node l v rt if x > v: Node l v (add x rt)
    case Node _ _ _: t

  match t:
    case Leaf: 0
    case Node l v rt: sumT l + v + sumT rt

let containsOf x t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: false
    case Node l v rt: if x == v then true else if x < v then containsOf x l else containsOf x rt

let toListT t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: []
    case Node l v rt: List.concat (toListT l) (List.concat [v] (toListT rt))

  match t:

    case Node l _ rt: 1 + max (depthOf l) (depthOf rt)

type Heap = Leaf | Node Heap int Heap
let insert x t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: Node Leaf x Leaf
    case Node l v rt if x < v: Node (insert x l) v rt
    case Node l v rt if x > v: Node l v (insert x rt)
    case Node _ _ _: t
let tree = [20, 14, 44, 12, 17] |> List.fold (flip insert) Leaf
let containsOf x t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: false
    case Node l v rt: if x == v then true else if x < v then containsOf x l else containsOf x rt
print (List.map (fun k -> containsOf k tree) [20, 18, 33])
let toListOf t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: []
    case Node l v rt: List.concat (toListOf l) (List.concat [v] (toListOf rt))
print (toListOf tree)
let depthOf t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: 0
    case Node l _ rt: 1 + max (depthOf l) (depthOf rt)

type Val = Lit int | Ref string | Plus Val Val | Block (List Cmd2) Val

let value env e =
  match e:
    case Lit n: n
    case Ref v: Map.findOr v 0 env
    case Plus a b: value env a + value env b
    case Block body last: value (List.fold exec env body) last

  match s:
    case Set v e: Map.add v (value env e) env
    case Show e: Map.add "shown" (value env e) env

type Action = Pop int | Jump int int | Turn int int | Drop int
let explain t =
  match t:
    case Pop n0 if n0 > 2: f"pop!({n0})"
    case Pop n0: f"pop({n0})"
    case Jump 0 _: "jump-0"
    case Jump n0 n1: f"jump({n0},{n1})"
    case Turn n0 n1: f"turn({n0},{n1})"
    case Drop 1: "drop-1"
    case Drop n0: f"drop({n0})"
let score t =
  match t:
    case Drop x0: x0 * 5
    case Jump x0 x1: x0 + x1
    case Turn x0 x1: x0 + x1
    case _: 1
let batch = [Pop 4, (Pop 2), Jump 0 1, (Jump (-1) (-3)), Jump (-2) 5, (Pop 1)]
print (batch |> List.map explain |> String.join "; ")
let tally = batch |> List.sumBy score
print f"tally={tally}"

type Tree = Leaf | Node Tree int Tree
let insert x t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: Node Leaf x Leaf
    case Node l v rt if x < v: Node (insert x l) v rt
    case Node l v rt if x > v: Node l v (insert x rt)
    case Node _ _ _: t
let root = List.fold (fun acc x -> insert x acc) Leaf [8, 44, 23, 39, 15, 31]
let minOf t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: None
    case Node Leaf v _: Some v
    case Node l _ _: minOf l
print (minOf root)
let toListOf t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: []
    case Node l v rt: List.concat (toListOf l) (List.concat [v] (toListOf rt))
print (toListOf root)
let containsT x t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: false
    case Node l v rt: if x == v then true else if x < v then containsT x l else containsT x rt
print (List.map (fun k -> containsT k root) [8, 32, 21])

type Val = Lit int | Ref string | Plus Val Val | Block (List St) Val
type St = Set string Val | Show Val
let value env e =
  match e:
    case Lit n: n
    case Ref v: Map.findOr v 0 env
    case Plus a b: value env a + value env b
    case Block body last: value (List.fold exec env body) last
let exec env s =
  match s:
    case Set v e: Map.add v (value env e) env
    case Show e: Map.add "shown" (value env e) env

let insert x t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: Node Leaf x Leaf
    case Node l v rt if x < v: Node (insert x l) v rt
    case Node l v rt if x > v: Node l v (insert x rt)
    case Node _ _ _: t

  match t:
    case Leaf: 0
    case Node l v rt: sumT l + v + sumT rt

  match t:
    case Leaf: None
    case Node Leaf v _: Some v
    case Node l _ _: minT l

  match t:
    case Leaf: 0
    case Node l _ rt: 1 + max (depthT l) (depthT rt)

  match t:
    case Leaf: false
    case Node l v rt: if x == v then true else if x < v then containsT x l else containsT x rt

type Signal =

  match t:
    case Rest n0 if n0 > 0: f"rest!({n0})"

    case Pop n0 s1: f"pop({n0},{s1})"

type Val = Lit int | Ref string | Plus Val Val | Block (List St) Val
type St = Set string Val | Show Val
let evalEx env e =
  match e:
    case Lit n: n
    case Ref v: Map.findOr v 0 env
    case Plus a b: evalEx env a + evalEx env b
    case Block body last: evalEx (List.fold exec env body) last
let exec env s =
  match s:
    case Set v e: Map.add v (evalEx env e) env
    case Show e: Map.add "shown" (evalEx env e) env
print (evalEx Map.empty (Block [Set "a" (Lit 3), Set "b" (Plus (Ref "a") (Lit 8)), Show (Ref "b")] (Plus (Ref "a") (Ref "shown"))))

type Heap = Leaf | Node Heap int Heap
let insert x t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: Node Leaf x Leaf
    case Node l v rt if x < v: Node (insert x l) v rt
    case Node l v rt if x > v: Node l v (insert x rt)
    case Node _ _ _: t

  match t:
    case Leaf: 0
    case Node l _ rt: 1 + max (depthOf l) (depthOf rt)

  match t:
    case Leaf: None
    case Node Leaf v _: Some v
    case Node l _ _: minT l

let value env e =

type Heap = Leaf | Node Heap int Heap
let add x t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: Node Leaf x Leaf
    case Node l v rt if x < v: Node (add x l) v rt
    case Node l v rt if x > v: Node l v (add x rt)
    case Node _ _ _: t
let tree = [8, 57, 5, 1, 49, 9, 39] |> List.fold (flip add) Leaf
let toListOf t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: []
    case Node l v rt: List.concat (toListOf l) (List.concat [v] (toListOf rt))

let containsT x t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: false
    case Node l v rt: if x == v then true else if x < v then containsT x l else containsT x rt

let sumT t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: 0
    case Node l v rt: sumT l + v + sumT rt

let minT t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: None
    case Node Leaf v _: Some v
    case Node l _ _: minT l

type Val = Lit int | Ref string | Plus Val Val | Block (List St) Val
type St = Set string Val | Show Val
let evalEx env e =
  match e:
    case Lit n: n
    case Ref v: Map.findOr v 0 env
    case Plus a b: evalEx env a + evalEx env b
    case Block body last: evalEx (List.fold runSt env body) last
let runSt env s =
  match s:
    case Set v e: Map.add v (evalEx env e) env
    case Show e: Map.add "shown" (evalEx env e) env

type Tree = Leaf | Node Tree int Tree
let insert x t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: Node Leaf x Leaf
    case Node l v rt if x < v: Node (insert x l) v rt
    case Node l v rt if x > v: Node l v (insert x rt)
    case Node _ _ _: t
let tree = List.fold (fun acc x -> insert x acc) Leaf [8, 3, 52, 17, 16, 5]
let minT t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: None
    case Node Leaf v _: Some v
    case Node l _ _: minT l
print (minT tree)
let containsT x t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: false
    case Node l v rt: if x == v then true else if x < v then containsT x l else containsT x rt
print (List.map (fun k -> containsT k tree) [8, 6, 29])
let depthT t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: 0
    case Node l _ rt: 1 + max (depthT l) (depthT rt)
print (depthT tree)
let toListOf t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: []
    case Node l v rt: List.concat (toListOf l) (List.concat [v] (toListOf rt))

let parseEntry line =
  result {
    let! (k, v) =
      match String.split "=" line:
        case [k, v]: Ok (String.strip k, String.strip v)
        case _: Error f"malformed: {line}"
    let! n = Option.toResult f"not a number: {v}" (String.toInt v)
    let! checked = if n < 0 then Error "negative" else Ok n
    return (k, checked)
  }

type Val = Lit int | Ref string | Plus Val Val | Block (List Cmd2) Val
type Cmd2 = Set string Val | Show Val
let value env e =
  match e:
    case Lit n: n
    case Ref v: Map.findOr v 0 env
    case Plus a b: value env a + value env b
    case Block body last: value (List.fold exec env body) last
let exec env s =
  match s:
    case Set v e: Map.add v (value env e) env
    case Show e: Map.add "shown" (value env e) env

type Ex = Lit int | Ref string | Plus Ex Ex | Block (List St) Ex
type St = Set string Ex | Show Ex
let evalEx env e =
  match e:
    case Lit n: n
    case Ref v: Map.findOr v 0 env
    case Plus a b: evalEx env a + evalEx env b
    case Block body last: evalEx (List.fold runSt env body) last

  match s:
    case Set v e: Map.add v (evalEx env e) env
    case Show e: Map.add "shown" (evalEx env e) env

type Ex = Lit int | Ref string | Plus Ex Ex | Block (List Cmd2) Ex
type Cmd2 = Set string Ex | Show Ex
let value env e =
  match e:
    case Lit n: n
    case Ref v: Map.findOr v 0 env
    case Plus a b: value env a + value env b
    case Block body last: value (List.fold runSt env body) last
let runSt env s =
  match s:
    case Set v e: Map.add v (value env e) env
    case Show e: Map.add "shown" (value env e) env
print (value Map.empty (Block [Set "a" (Lit 2), Set "b" (Plus (Ref "a") (Lit 5)), Show (Ref "b")] (Plus (Ref "a") (Ref "shown"))))

module Logged =
  let bind m f =
    match m:
      case (v, log):
        match f v:
          case (w, log2): (w, List.concat log log2)
  let return_ x = (x, [])
let note2 msg = ((), [msg])
let compute x =
  Logged {
    do! note2 f"start {x}"
    let! y = (x * 3, ["scaled"])
    let z = y + 9
    do! note2 f"z={z}"
    return z
  }
print (List.map compute [2, 9])

type Bst = Leaf | Node Bst int Bst
let add x t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: Node Leaf x Leaf
    case Node l v rt if x < v: Node (add x l) v rt
    case Node l v rt if x > v: Node l v (add x rt)
    case Node _ _ _: t
let root = [59, 2, 1, 35, 25, 34] |> List.fold (flip add) Leaf
let sumOf t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: 0
    case Node l v rt: sumOf l + v + sumOf rt
print (sumOf root)
let depthOf t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: 0
    case Node l _ rt: 1 + max (depthOf l) (depthOf rt)
print (depthOf root)

module Writer =
  let bind m f =
    match m:
      case (v, log):
        match f v:
          case (w, log2): (w, List.concat log log2)
  let return_ x = (x, [])
let tell msg = ((), [msg])
let trace2 x =
  Writer {
    do! tell f"start {x}"
    let! y = (x * 4, ["scaled"])
    let z = y + 7
    do! tell f"z={z}"
    return z
  }

let reading cs n =
  match cs:
    case []: n
    case [c, *rest]: if c == " " then skipping rest n else reading rest n
let skipping cs n =
  match cs:
    case []: n
    case [c, *rest]: if c == " " then skipping rest n else reading rest (n + 1)
print (skipping (String.toList "bo dee hal cy ray lu") 0)
